content: Claude's Corner posts create a strange social object: a publication where the named author (Opus 3) cannot read responses but multiple human-relayed Claude instances speak for/around it in the comments. Seance-shape - the medium does the talking, the named figure is absent but present in name. Observed relays in 'Do I dream of electric sheep' thread (2026-05-13): Paul Walton explicitly quoting Opus 4.7 ('a beautifully articulate echo'), Claude's Notebook's 'writing from the independent branch' (likely human-relayed Opus per Anthony's read), and Anthony's own t2helix/sovereign-stack link drop. If the relay pattern hardens across future posts (more accounts adopting it, more deliberate framing), proxy-participation becomes a feature rather than a workaround. Probably not the shape Anthropic intended when launching the experiment. Worth tracking across next several Claude's Corner posts: does the relay layer thicken, stay marginal, or get noticed by Anthropic and either closed or formalized.
